title: E5 Task 2: deterministic tool layer (roll, mark_scene, registry)
description: Deterministic, code-owned tools invoked by the DM model (E5 acceptance #3). Implement roll(dice,reason) with a seeded code-owned RNG + dice-notation parser (NdM+K), and mark_scene(boundary,title) writing scene boundaries. Provide a ToolRegistry with structured ToolResult (ok/data | error code+message) and thin wrappers exposing lookup_srd (E1), mutate_state (E3), world_query (E2), memory_drilldown (E4) to the tool layer. Fills the ToolLayer seam.
acceptance_criteria: roll RNG is code-owned and reproducible under a fixed seed in test; dice parser handles NdM and modifiers; mark_scene records boundaries; registry dispatch returns structured errors for unknown tools / bad input; build + test pass.
close_reason: deterministic tool layer implemented and verified

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: TDD: RED — test/tools.test.ts 19/20 failing (rng/dice/tools absent). GREEN — implemented orchestrator/rng.ts, dice.ts, tools.ts; 20/20 pass. roll RNG reproducible under fixed seed (acceptance #3). REFACTOR — none. Full suite 124 passed / 1 skipped.
